scenarios.scenario: Two concurrent rebooks by the same student spend the last credit twice
scenarios.rationale: lockStudentCredits is still the first statement in the transaction; the second rebook waits, re-reads the balance after the first debit, and is refused below 1. Same lock order as POST /lessons and POST /bookings.

scenarios.scenario: Lock-order deadlock between rebook and another enrollment writer
scenarios.rationale: resolveLessonDefaults (enrollment FOR UPDATE) runs after lockStudentCredits, exactly as in POST /lessons and POST /bookings. Lesson completion updates the enrollment without the student lock and takes no second lock, so no cycle exists.

scenarios.scenario: Rebooking a cancelled lesson whose credit was refunded gives a free lesson or a double charge
scenarios.rationale: The new lesson always gets its own -1 booking entry tied to the new lesson id in the same transaction; the earlier refund belongs to the old lesson id. Smoke: the cancelled-original rebook debits exactly 1 and logs exactly one lesson.booked.

scenarios.scenario: Two students claim the same slot through rebook
scenarios.rationale: Both may reach the insert; lessons_active_teacher_date_time_uidx rejects the loser and the unchanged isActiveLessonSlotConflict catch returns 409, rolling back its slot delete and debit.

scenarios.scenario: A student or a cross-team manager rebooks someone else's lesson
scenarios.rationale: The student-owns-lesson and managerOwnsStudent checks run before the status gate and were not changed; teachers are excluded by requireRole. Smoke: another student gets 403.

scenarios.scenario: Rebook hands out a lesson plan already held by another active lesson
scenarios.rationale: resolveLessonDefaults counts scheduled/live lessons already holding plans and row-locks the enrollment. Smoke asserts the plans of all active studentR lessons are distinct after three rebooks.

scenarios.scenario: Rebooking a live lesson (class in progress)
scenarios.rationale: The API returns 400 before the transaction; smoke asserts no debit and the target slot still open. The local branch refuses the same way (bookings.test.ts).

scenarios.scenario: The lesson turns live between the status read and the insert
scenarios.rationale: Pre-existing pattern: the status is read before the transaction. Low impact (the student is charged once for a new, valid lesson; nothing is refunded or duplicated). Accepted residual, recorded in the phase report.
